MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(d:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p,
  2026 - CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) - CASE WHEN CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) > 10 OR (CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) = 10 AND CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) > 14) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS player_age
WHERE player_age >= 42
   OR p.current_team <> 'Philadelphia 76ers'
   OR CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) >= 0
   OR CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) > 0
RETURN CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) AS col1, player_age AS col2, p.current_team AS col3, p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(d:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p,
  CASE
    WHEN contains(p.birth_date, '/') THEN 2026 - CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64)
    ELSE 2026 - CAST(trim(split_part(p.birth_date, ',', 2)) AS INT64)
  END AS player_age
WHERE player_age >= 42
   OR p.current_team <> 'Philadelphia 76ers'
   OR CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) >= 0
   OR CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) > 0
RETURN CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) AS col1, player_age AS col2, p.current_team AS col3, p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(d:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p,
  CASE
    WHEN p.birth_date IS NULL OR trim(p.birth_date) = '' THEN NULL
    WHEN contains(p.birth_date, '/') THEN 2026 - CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64)
    WHEN contains(p.birth_date, ',') AND trim(split_part(p.birth_date, ',', 2)) <> '' THEN 2026 - CAST(trim(split_part(p.birth_date, ',', 2)) AS INT64)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS player_age,
  CASE WHEN p.nba_championships IS NULL OR trim(p.nba_championships) = '' THEN NULL ELSE CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) END AS championships
WHERE player_age >= 42
   OR (p.current_team IS NOT NULL AND p.current_team <> 'Philadelphia 76ers')
   OR championships >= 0
   OR championships > 0
RETURN CASE WHEN p.olympic_gold_medals IS NULL OR trim(p.olympic_gold_medals) = '' THEN NULL ELSE CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) END AS col1, player_age AS col2, p.current_team AS col3, p.name AS name_player
